description: Today, Alaskans for Mary launched “Veterans for Mary,” a group made up of more than 100 founding members representing Alaska veterans from all branches of the military who are supporting lifelong Alaskan and military mom Mary Peltola in her bid for U.S. Senate, citing her tireless record of advocacy and her plan to strengthen and expand benefits, lower costs, improve VA healthcare, and fight for servicemembers, veterans, and their families.

title: Mary Peltola Campaign Launches “Veterans for Mary” Coalition With More Than 100 Founding Members - Mary Peltola
